fusions.name: Reefshard
fusions.desc: Breaks a branch off the reef grown over the shield, at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, and throws it. It deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 60% chance to leave it [Slow Learner] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wave-Breaker
fusions.desc: Braces the reef-crusted shield and breaks forward through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 26 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or elite it adds 5% of the target's maximum health.

fusions.name: Sheltering Reef
fusions.desc: Raises a living reef around the shield where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you gain a shield that soaks 3% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
